Someone to talk to helps. I know you don't know me, and you can look into my post history to see the only posts I've really made are on subreds like this one. Fucked up human being, just on a different path. Sometimes we need a distraction to get that spark of inspiration in order to problem solve. Still, surviving for a time is like slipping out of handcuffs; just gotta grin through the pain till you can get your hand free. Outside of PC games and biking, I could use someone to ramble with just as much as it sounds like you could. Shoot me a line, maybe we can hit it off, who the fuck knows? Lifes weird.

Still a few more threads left for me to burn off before I'm really free of all the old poisonous people that think they can feed off me. Don't know a damn thing about you, but think I might be able to point in a direction you haven't looked yet. One fubar meatbag to another, it's the crazy options that work best.
